name: firstmate-fleet
description: Firstmate Fleet for Claude Code: the /fleet pane, one above-prompt line naming what waits on the captain, and a transient notice when a task first reaches done, blocked, or failed, all read from bin/fm-fleet-snapshot.sh on a timer. Claude Code loads its hooks module on its own terms, but the mod activates only when FM_FLEET_ENABLED is exactly 1 and is otherwise a complete no-op.
